changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Long-form QA' as it wasn't explicitly mentioned as a separate task (ELI5 is included under Question Answering). Removed MSMARCO-QA as it was only used in utility attribution evaluation, not main NLG evaluation. Removed retrieval models (Contriever, BGE) as they are not NLG models. Normalized dataset names and simplified output descriptions.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE following metric simplification rules. Kept only base metric names.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in the paper. LLMs were only used as generators in the RALM pipeline.
No human evaluation was conducted in the paper. All evaluations used automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving retrievers for Retrieval-Augmented Language Models across multiple NLG tasks. Evaluation is comprehensive but relies exclusively on automatic metrics without human or LLM-judge assessments. The extraction was generally good but needed normalization and removal of non-NLG components.
